mechanism_narrative: The steady recovery in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT over the last three weekly means signals more routine daytime circulation, which lifts retail and recreation visits with a one- to four-week lag.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains more negative over the next 28 days than over the previous 28 days despite continued week-on-week improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility stays elevated while WORKPLACES remain far below baseline, discretionary trips shift toward neighborhood shopping and recreation, raising RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above 10 points and WORKPLACES below -20 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL stays above 10 and WORKPLACES stays below -20 for at least one week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to become less negative over the next 28 days after GROCERY_PHARM crosses above -5.

mechanism_narrative: Further contraction in PARKS mobility reduces outdoor substitute activity and leaves more time for indoor discretionary shopping, which pushes RETAIL_REC upward over the next week.
